groups.label: The camera answers the body
groups.plain: The camera answers the body: when the camera goes handheld, gesture grows; when a person approaches, the camera pushes in; when an object enters, the frame becomes an insert. An insert is a very close shot of a small thing, like a hand or a key.

groups.label: Feeling sets the camera height
groups.plain: When the feeling changes, the camera's height changes, and so does its attitude (gentle or aggressive).

groups.label: Loudness and frame size
groups.plain: Loudness and frame size: when shot size becomes close, volume drops; when volume rises, move speed rises.

groups.label: Weather and surface
groups.plain: Weather and surface: when it rains, surfaces are soaked; when the render goes toon, the ink line is heavy; when impacts rise, the shake rises. Its toon line and impact shake pairs are not about weather; they may belong elsewhere.

groups.label: Long-form shape
groups.plain: Long-form shape: when suite Build, suite Drop; when suite Aggressive camera, suite Quiet confession; when suite Storm, suite Breathing room; when tension peaks, a long silence; when energy drops, the hold is long.

groups.label: Music steers the edit
groups.plain: The music sets when cuts happen, when time slows and when the room goes quiet.

groups.label: Silence as a weapon
groups.plain: Taking the music away makes lines, reveals and faces hit harder.

groups.label: The body tells first
groups.plain: Feelings reach the face and body before they reach the words.

groups.label: Emotional rollercoaster
groups.plain: The film's feeling rises and falls in a rhythm: tension then release, low then a laugh, a low point that turns.

groups.label: Feelings spread
groups.plain: A feeling moves outward from one character to the others, the room and the light.

groups.label: Joke machine
groups.plain: The basic comic beat: a pause, the punchline, the reaction, and a silence after a miss.

groups.label: Long-game comedy
groups.plain: Jokes that play across the whole film: setups that pay off, gags that return, lines that come back tender.

groups.label: Comic reversals
groups.plain: Comedy from things turning around: pride falls, refusals reverse, misdirection is revealed.

groups.label: The camera sells the joke
groups.plain: Where the camera goes for comedy: wider as trouble escalates, onto faces after the joke, back to reveal the truth.

groups.label: The mix makes it funny
groups.plain: Putting the wrong people together: opposites, a chaos character, a gap in rank, and what it does to the plot.

groups.label: Clothes tell the story
groups.plain: What people wear changes when they change, gives them away, and gets noticed.

groups.label: The set steers the camera
groups.plain: The size, clutter and props of a set decide how close the camera gets.

groups.label: Light follows loss and reunion
groups.plain: The light and color change with what the characters feel.

groups.label: Stress arrows
groups.plain: All nine types sliding toward their stress type as health falls.

groups.label: Growth arrows
groups.plain: All nine types borrowing from their growth type as health improves.

groups.label: Secrets and lies
groups.plain: A slipping secret makes the room cringe, the setbacks pile up, and the feeling drops.

groups.label: Eyes on one thing
groups.plain: Fixation narrows the frame while a distraction lets the important thing slip by.

groups.label: The group closes ranks
groups.plain: Someone defies the group, the pressure rises, and the doubts go quiet.

groups.label: The page breathes with the story
groups.plain: Panels grow at the peaks, shrink when talk speeds up, and the page turns on a cliffhanger.

groups.label: Closing in
groups.plain: People move closer, look at each other, and the camera pushes in.

groups.label: The world mirrors the feeling
groups.plain: The weather and the background follow the characters' feelings.

groups.label: Color follows anger, fear and joy
groups.plain: Anger warms the picture, fear drains it, joy warms the light. Close to "Light follows loss and reunion"; both share joy warming the light.

groups.label: The dam breaks
groups.plain: A trigger turns the feeling, what was held in comes out, and the character is lighter after.

groups.label: What isn't said
groups.plain: Words and meaning pull apart, pauses grow, the face flickers and the camera moves in on the eyes.

groups.label: Closeness and dread
groups.plain: People move closer and feel more while we, knowing more, dread what is coming.

groups.label: The farce engine
groups.plain: A misunderstanding grows the chaos, a lie needs a bigger lie, the lie collapses and someone is humiliated.

groups.label: Stacking laughs
groups.plain: A joke lands, a topper follows, and the specific detail comes back later as a callback.

groups.label: Comedy of a flaw
groups.plain: A blind flaw trips the character up, they're humiliated, and the room cringes.

groups.label: The house party engine
groups.plain: An unwanted guest brings chaos, the calm one sells the laugh, and sides switch until someone is on top.

groups.label: The secret in the room
groups.plain: The outsider nears the truth, the room squirms, and the group closes ranks. Close to "Secrets and lies"; that one follows a secret slipping and the setbacks, this one the outsider getting close.

groups.label: The pair that grows
groups.plain: Egos clash, the plot detours, and the chemistry changes them both.

groups.label: The fall and the rise
groups.plain: A false high falls, hope is lost, and the release comes later.

groups.label: Rest after a big feeling
groups.plain: A big feeling is followed by rest, and lifted dread by a laugh. Not "Breathing room", which sets a quiet, empty, long-held moment.

groups.label: The pressure cooker
groups.plain: Stakes rise, hope gets fragile, dread builds and the music thins out.

groups.label: The arc engine
groups.plain: The wound is pressed, they resist, the lie is exposed, the crisis comes, and the change shows.

groups.label: The body moves with the words
groups.plain: The body freezes on the key word, the listener leans in, and anger goes into the task. Close in name to "The body tells first", which is the feeling showing before the words; this one is the body moving with them.

groups.label: Comic business
groups.plain: Jokes against change and a task that falls apart.

groups.label: The camera follows the feeling
groups.plain: The camera moves in at the peak, tilts with dread, and looks up when status flips. Close to "Feeling sets the camera height"; this one moves closer at the peak, tilts with dread and looks up when status flips.

groups.label: Movement drives the cutting
groups.plain: Speed brings fast cuts, walking talk brings long takes, and an approach closes the space.

groups.label: The editor tells the joke
groups.plain: When the joke pays off the editor punches in and a sound hits; rhythmic jump cuts build the next joke; a rewind gets its own sound.

groups.label: Featured music drives the edit
groups.plain: Featured music pulls the cuts onto the beat, slow motion lifts the music, and a scene that races then stops fades out. Close to "Music steers the edit"; that one starts from the tempo and builds to silence, this one starts from featured music and ends in a fade out.

groups.label: Words that point
groups.plain: A freeze brings a title, and a label follows what it names.

groups.label: Phone comedy reactions
groups.plain: The joke pays off and a mood pops onto a face, anger brings steam, and an impact brings a slam zoom.

groups.label: The face tells the feeling
groups.plain: Every feeling brings its cartoon mood onto the face: hearts, a sun, tears, a blush, a soul leaving, a light bulb, shades, question marks.

groups.label: The mood moves the feeling
groups.plain: Mood stickers push the feeling: tears drop it, a sun lifts it, steam and crackles wind it up, a mallet makes it absurd, laughing till crying makes the audience laugh. Runs the other way from "The face tells the feeling"; with both on, each sets off the other in a loop.

groups.label: Effects show the inside
groups.plain: What a character feels shows on the picture: triumph lights the eyes, panic glitches the frame, a dream spins the room or blooms with light.

groups.label: Questions pull the audience forward
groups.plain: Cliffhangers and opening questions open questions the audience carries forward, and a running clock speeds the cutting.

groups.label: Weather hits everyone
groups.plain: Wind and rain reach everything loose: cloth flies out, hair streams, then goes stringy.

groups.label: The impact chain
groups.plain: A crash shakes the camera, loose parts settle a beat later, and the mess spreads.

groups.label: Acting from the inside out
groups.plain: The eyes move first, then the face, then the whole body.

groups.label: The elements build
groups.plain: Fire warms faces and churning water foams: the world reacts to its elements.

groups.label: Whose eyes are these?
groups.plain: Handing over the camera makes the view personal, the view starts to shake, a lying narrator splits words from picture, and that split gets a laugh.

groups.label: Choosing the angle
groups.plain: More angles mean more cuts; angles picked for lines or moves decide where cuts fall; angles that fight the scene make it funny or tense.

groups.label: Camera moves with a reason
groups.plain: The camera moves because something gave it a reason: a walk, a person to follow, a breath, or a loud bang.

groups.label: Coming at the lens
groups.plain: A character walks up to the camera, their reaching hand grows huge, and the audience flinches.

groups.label: Cartoon physics
groups.plain: A big wind-up, a snapping move, a bounce past the mark and hair that keeps swinging: the chain that makes cartoons feel alive and fun.

groups.label: Smooth or stiff
groups.plain: How fast a character moves and talks decides how often they are drawn and posed, and straight paths make them robotic.

groups.label: The eyes give it away
groups.plain: Darting eyes read as nerves, nerves bring fast blinking, and a glance at something pulls the whole body round.

groups.label: Dinner gets messy
groups.plain: Food on the table means talking with a full mouth, muddy words to clean up, and chewing pauses that time the jokes.

groups.label: Speed and impact
groups.plain: Fast things blur, crisp frames feel harsh, and every drop and quick cut gets a sound hit.

groups.label: Where the eye goes
groups.plain: Soft backgrounds and focus shifts steer the audience to a face, and a sharp door promises an entrance.

groups.label: Sound of the place
groups.plain: The next place is heard before it is seen, outside brings the off-screen world in, and more people make it busier.

groups.label: Deadpan storybook
groups.plain: Patterns push the subject to dead center, and dead center makes oddness funny.

groups.label: The volume curve
groups.plain: Whispers empty the room, big swings hit the top of the mix, the climax is loudest, and the ending fades away.

groups.label: Talking fast
groups.plain: Quick talk brings quick cuts and simpler poses, and once people talk over each other it becomes comedy.

groups.label: Night comes down
groups.plain: Night falls, the light turns to blue moonlight, and the people in it start to feel far apart.

groups.label: The golden hour turn
groups.plain: Dusk light arrives, changes while the camera holds, and the feeling in the face swells with it.

groups.label: Lamplit closeness
groups.plain: A lamp in the shot, warm light from it, a cozy room, and people drawing close.

groups.label: Noir squeeze
groups.plain: Side light, rising contrast, a dark picture (low key: mostly dark with deep shadows) and characters hiding what they mean: the classic crime-film tightening, starting from the light.

groups.label: Smoky blinds
groups.plain: Haze turns blind light into visible bars, and the bars make the person feel caged.

groups.label: Halo from behind
groups.plain: Light moves behind the actor, an edge of light appears, the hair shines and the person lifts off the background.

groups.label: One red thing
groups.plain: The colors narrow, one thing pops, and the audience can't stop watching it.

groups.label: Wet neon street
groups.plain: A soaked street turns to a mirror and every sign and lamp shows up twice.

groups.label: Smash and scatter
groups.plain: A gag goes too far, something shatters, and the pieces fly everywhere.

groups.label: Bath time disaster
groups.plain: The fur gets soaked, mats into clumps, and the proud animal looks ridiculous.

groups.label: Long coat in motion
groups.plain: Long fur trails behind each move and keeps swinging after the body stops.

groups.label: Lost in the smoke
groups.plain: Smoke builds into a wall and the hero's world closes in to the one person they can still see.

groups.label: Fire takes the room
groups.plain: Fire appears, flickers across faces, then floods the scene with orange light.

groups.label: Splash hang time
groups.plain: A splash bursts, the edit slows right down, and smooth in-between frames keep every drop clean.

groups.label: The standout hero
groups.plain: Dress the crowd down, the hero becomes the only one dressed that way, and the eye finds them every time.

groups.label: Dressed wrong for it
groups.plain: Pretty clothes for a practical job, then baggy clothes that snag: the outfit sets up the comedy.

groups.label: The rigid room gag
groups.plain: A perfectly arranged room tells us the owner is rigid, and a deep set gives the joke a place to land behind them.

groups.label: Dark room secrets
groups.plain: Dark walls push the picture into low key, and in the dark people stop saying what they mean. Close to "Noir squeeze"; same ending, but this one starts from the set.

groups.label: Memory box
groups.plain: An old photo look, copies stacked like snapshots, and home video that feels happy and sad at once.

groups.label: Hard-edge grade
groups.plain: Crushed blacks push the contrast up, the picture goes dark, and the characters start hiding things. Close to "Noir squeeze"; same ending, but this one starts in the edit.

groups.label: The hyper edit
groups.plain: Explosive transitions, something new every second or two, and jokes forced to land faster.

groups.label: Put me somewhere else
groups.plain: Cut the person out, drop a scenery clip behind them, and the flat shot gains real depth.

groups.label: The power-up moment
groups.plain: The body lights up with power, an aura locks the eye on the hero, and the stakes climb.

groups.label: The squeeze
groups.plain: Two groups, faster cross-cutting, a tighter clock, quicker scenes, rising tension and shorter scenes again. The classic way a finale speeds up.

groups.label: The loud page
groups.plain: Fewer words make room for bigger pictures, a full-page picture gets a giant sound effect, and the sound bursts the frame.

groups.label: Knowing too much
groups.plain: Hopping between characters lets us know first, knowing first fills calm moments with dread, and dread narrows a character's attention into a fixation.

groups.label: The cartoon spiral
groups.plain: A clear comic idea gets pushed further, everything gets exaggerated, and it tips into the absurd.

groups.label: The calm one cracks
groups.plain: The straight one stays calm while disasters get shrugged off, until they finally lose it for the biggest laugh.

groups.label: Caring wider leads to change
groups.plain: Caring wider lines up want and need, they act on their belief, the choice changes them, and the change shows. Close to "Ends better than they began", which sets where the arc ends; this one is the chain of causes that gets them there.

groups.label: Holding it in, until
groups.plain: Clenched hands lead to bigger actions, the actions make the voice crack, and the crack brings the tears.

groups.label: The side story takes over
groups.plain: More screen time makes a character's own story heavier, it gets pulled into the main plot, and the stakes jump.

groups.label: The flop spiral
groups.plain: A joke dies, the silence stretches, the teller explains it, the ramble makes it worse, and the cringe peaks.

groups.label: Petty quest to ruin
groups.plain: A tiny want meets huge effort, a montage of failures escalates it, the prize is won and ruined, and the humiliation makes everyone cringe.

groups.label: Epic fuss, then popped
groups.plain: Something tiny gets the slow-motion hero treatment, a smash cut pops it, a topper follows and a button closes the scene. A smash cut is a sudden hard cut to something opposite; a button is one small last laugh that closes the scene.

groups.label: Chase to crash
groups.plain: The trap is shown, the music copies every step, the chase picks up, things crash, and cartoon rules mean nobody really gets hurt.

groups.label: Roast night
groups.plain: An insult stings, a better comeback answers, one goes too far and the room stops dead, then the love underneath warms things back up.

groups.label: Laugh, then cry
groups.plain: Self-mockery hides hurt, the joke turns sad on one line, the music drops away, and the tears finally tip back into a laugh.

groups.label: Sitcom scene shape
groups.plain: Set up the catchphrase, a joke lands, a topper follows, a button closes the scene, and the tag brings back an old joke. Shares the topper pair with "Stacking laughs"; this one is the shape of a whole sitcom scene. A button is one small last laugh that closes a scene; the tag is a short extra bit after the story ends.

groups.label: Farce at the doors
groups.plain: Two people just miss each other, tension jumps, the disguise slips and the lie grows, until the near misses tip the room into chaos. Close to "The farce engine"; this one is the doors and disguises kind.

groups.label: From loss to letting go
groups.plain: Hope dies, grief sets in, a laugh slips through, the tears come, and the release arrives.

groups.label: Betrayed, then forgiven
groups.plain: Trust breaks, warmth cools, a grudge grows and boils over, until forgiveness warms things again and brings release.

groups.label: Shame spiral
groups.plain: An old wound or a public humiliation brings shame, the eyes drop and the whole room squirms.

groups.label: Getting it off their chest
groups.plain: Guilt piles up and twists their words until they make it right, relief floods in and the breath slows.

groups.label: The ache of missing
groups.plain: An old tune brings back the past, the past turns into longing, longing into loneliness, and the frame and music empty out.

groups.label: Earning the tears
groups.plain: Close faces and small kindnesses win us over, so the tears feel earned, the release lands, and the ending stays with us.

groups.label: Too much sugar backfires
groups.plain: Music turned up too high makes a scene syrupy, and the audience pulls back instead of leaning in.

groups.label: Envy turns sour
groups.plain: Jealousy opens a gap, hardens into a grudge, and finally boils over into anger.

groups.label: Plan to pieces
groups.plain: The whole plan is told, it falls apart, the hidden part flips everything, and the goal slips away.

groups.label: The line crossed
groups.plain: A costly choice is made, the feeling is held in, there is no going back, and the stakes rise.

groups.label: Enemy at the door
groups.plain: The other side moves, dread grows, they reach the door, things get worse, tension climbs and hope drops.

groups.label: Clue in plain sight
groups.plain: An object is planted, the camera keeps coming back to it, questions grow, a lingering shot gives it away, and the reveal lands.

groups.label: Finally seeing
groups.plain: The blind spot opens, they understand, they give something up, and the change shows.

groups.label: Talked into it
groups.plain: Excuses pile up, they slip back into old ways, and they talk themselves over a line they cannot uncross.

groups.label: From rumor to rally
groups.plain: A rumor turns the crowd, one person speaks up, openly defies them, and wins the room back.

groups.label: The hit we never see
groups.plain: The film cuts away before the blow, the screen goes black and silent, time jumps ahead, and later a slow reveal shows what was left.

groups.label: Time gets away
groups.plain: The world races past someone sitting still, the story skips ahead, and a card tells us how many years went by.

groups.label: One second, forever
groups.plain: A life or death moment is stretched across the faces watching, the tension climbs, time freezes, and the hit lands hard.

groups.label: Red means run
groups.plain: A bright color keeps popping until it means trouble, every time it shows up dread rises, and the film cuts away before the worst.

groups.label: Worlds collide
groups.plain: Colors leak from one world to another, the storylines cross, and lines start jumping the cuts between them.

groups.label: The unsent message
groups.plain: A text is typed and deleted, the wait for a reply stretches, and the messages pile up until a secret slips out.

groups.label: The clock runs out
groups.plain: The repeating notes push harder, the music speeds up, the cuts come faster, the pattern crashes into a big hit, and then silence.

groups.label: Something is coming
groups.plain: The music warns us early, the bright tune turns dark, the notes start to clash, dread builds and the place itself goes quiet.

groups.label: The world goes quiet
groups.plain: The music moves inside one person, we start to hear through their ears, the background falls away, and the echo leaves them alone.

groups.label: From the room to the soundtrack
groups.plain: Someone hums the theme, a performance takes over, the song crosses into the soundtrack and comes forward, and the crowd's joy becomes pride.

groups.label: The theme comes home
groups.plain: The title music plants the theme, it plays for someone missed, the music turns from dark to bright, and the theme comes back heroic.

groups.label: Saving it for the end
groups.plain: Less music means longer silences, so when the saved music finally lands on the moment, the feeling peaks and stays after the film.

groups.label: The fight ends at the door
groups.plain: They square off and tension climbs, one shoots to their feet and takes the room, slams the door, and the one left behind is alone.

groups.label: The call
groups.plain: We cannot hear the other side, so the camera creeps in, the bad news turns their back, the tears stay hidden, and we feel it with them.

groups.label: The truth comes out sideways
groups.plain: The big line is thrown away into silence, the next one trails off, the body answers instead, and a line cut off before the key word leaves us with a question. Close to "What isn't said"; that one is about the face and the camera, this one about the lines.

groups.label: The ground gives way
groups.plain: The camera pushes in as they realise, the room stretches behind them, the sound drops away, and we feel it in our own body.

groups.label: Growing close
groups.plain: One copies the other's habit, they fall into step, stand closer, warm to each other, and the camera circles their kiss.

groups.label: Someone is there
groups.plain: The camera wanders off to a clue and lingers, then turns to find a person who arrives like an entrance, and the room goes quiet.

groups.label: Nowhere to run
groups.plain: The story stays in one place, the room feels more trapped, there are more places for danger to hide, and dread rises.

groups.label: Look behind you
groups.plain: The mirror shows someone behind them, we know before they do, the danger rushes in and tension spikes.

groups.label: Left out, then let in
groups.plain: Someone defies the group and ends up standing apart, the people behind carry on without them, loneliness grows, and then the group comes to them.

groups.label: The turn of power
groups.plain: One stands higher and the gap in rank grows, the near one fills the frame, and then the height flips and so does the power.

groups.label: Turn the page
groups.plain: The panels go silent, the reader fills in the gap, the page turn hides a reveal, and the full-page picture brings awe.

groups.label: A life in a room
groups.plain: The home place matters more, the room follows the character, their change shows, and in the end the place comes back to life with hope, or is lost to grief.

groups.label: The look darkens
groups.plain: The picture hardens as the trouble grows, tension climbs, the color drains and hope fades, the blacks swallow more and dread rises.

groups.label: The lie in the picture
groups.plain: The look gets too perfect and we trust it less, the colors go wrong and we doubt what we see, and then the perfect look breaks apart and everything flips.

groups.label: Apart, then together
groups.plain: Their feelings drift and the frame splits them, the one losing stands alone, then a touch puts them back in one shot and warmth returns.

groups.label: The small one's view
groups.plain: The camera stays at their height and we feel with them, the world towers and awe rises, and a parent kneels down and warmth returns.

groups.label: Enemy to ally
groups.plain: A shared enemy shifts the sides, the rivals come closer and warmth grows, and their sharp words keep the spark alive.

groups.label: The change you can wear
groups.plain: They finally see it and the clothes change, the new look shows the inner change, the clothes that were not theirs now fit, and the uniform comes off for good.

groups.label: The light turns on us
groups.plain: The clock runs and the lights start to fail, the flicker brings dread, a shadow towers over the room, and when the light comes back someone is gone.

groups.label: The weather of the heart
groups.plain: Grief brings the rain to the window, the rain on the glass makes longing grow, a streak runs over the cheek and we feel with them, and a sun that shines anyway mixes our feelings.

groups.label: Something in the fog
groups.plain: The fog thickens and the questions pile up, a shape comes out first as an outline, and it steps into the light to show who it is.

groups.label: The past lays over us
groups.plain: An old feeling brings a memory over the present, the memory brings nostalgia, it stays and follows them, and the last bit of color fades into grief.

groups.label: We know how it ends
groups.plain: The story runs backwards or flashes ahead, the ending feels fixed, the happy moments turn bittersweet, and the tears at the end are earned.

groups.label: The climb back
groups.plain: All seems lost and hope drops, then a small win comes, and with it hope rises again.

groups.label: From one overheard line
groups.plain: The wrong person overhears, the mix-up grows, they tell the whole room, and the speaker turns around to find them there.

groups.label: From cool to the door
groups.plain: The effort to look cool turns into copying, the act collapses into humiliation, and the long walk out brings shame and a slow clap.

groups.label: Plan to pandemonium
groups.plain: The careful plan fails at once, the improvised fix makes it worse, everyone jumps in, and every helper breaks something new.

groups.label: Manners at war
groups.plain: Strict manners push the fight underground, the rivals fight politely, the war turns real, and the room stops dead.

groups.label: From the wrong man to a farce
groups.plain: The wrong man plays along, the lie grows, the real one turns up, every problem meets in one room, and it ends in a chase.

groups.label: Questions that keep us watching
groups.plain: The answer almost comes, the closed box waits, the question is asked out loud and left open, and our questions pile up.

groups.label: Leaving at the peak
groups.plain: A cliffhanger and more cross-cutting make the film leave each story at its peak, and the question rides along into the next scene.

groups.label: Waking the middle
groups.plain: Nothing pulls and the audience drifts, so the fix opens a question or starts a clock, and a clear goal blocked by time gets us leaning in again.

groups.label: Rules and false trails
groups.plain: A firm rule builds dread and is broken by accident, while a false clue misleads us until the story flips at the end.

groups.label: The feeling that waits
groups.plain: Numbness holds the feeling in, it hits later somewhere ordinary, and the release is bigger for the wait.

groups.label: The gone and the silent
groups.plain: The empty place keeps returning, nobody can name it, dread builds, and when it is finally shouted the room breaks open.

groups.label: Saved and played small
groups.plain: The big feeling is saved and played small, the audience feels more than the character shows, and the tears are earned.

groups.label: Leaning on each other
groups.plain: Comfort taken warms them, the busy hands are stopped, the two trade places, and the slow-growing feeling warms them further.

groups.label: The voice in the head
groups.plain: The voice puts them down and shame grows, they freeze and replay the moment, guilt follows, until they talk back for good.

groups.label: Thinking traps
groups.plain: The role they cling to feeds their lie, black and white thinking misreads people, and the worst they imagine fills the room with dread.

groups.label: Silence in the crowd
groups.plain: Most keep quiet and the pressure grows, a rumor finds someone to blame, then the least likely person helps and the crowd turns.

groups.label: Changing for real
groups.plain: A brave first step brings hope, others notice, some pull them back, and a fake change gets tested until it is real.

groups.label: Pressure under the words
groups.plain: A line aimed through someone else, a question turned back, a subject changed, and one person doing all the talking: the real fight happens under the words.

groups.label: What slips out
groups.plain: A word taken back, a slip called out, the old voice coming back in anger, and a practiced line that falls apart.

groups.label: Close without looking
groups.plain: A whisper in a loud room, lines finished for each other, a name said for the first time, and a hard talk side by side.

groups.label: Doors and last words
groups.plain: Digs answered with digs turn into a fight for the last word, someone walks out, and the door between them is shut until a hand touches it.

groups.label: Colors that speak
groups.plain: Clashing colors raise the tension, one clashing piece spreads to the whole frame, a saved color brings back an old feeling, and two colored lights on a face turn into colors going wrong.

groups.label: Where the eye lands
groups.plain: The still one in the rush pulls the eye, a face in the crowd sharpens while the rest goes soft, a pulled-away eye lets danger in behind, and a person at the edge stands apart.

groups.label: Words that live in the world
groups.plain: Signs in the street pull the titles into the place, a short opening pushes the title later, a loud inner voice turns into words on screen, and lying words make us doubt the whole view.

groups.label: The frame tells it
groups.plain: A split screen raises the tension, a shrinking picture feels lonely, a keyhole view brings dread, and a run of still photos brings back the past.

groups.label: The telling turns
groups.plain: A voice talks to us, then the teller is caught lying, we see the moment again, and what was said and meant come apart.

groups.label: Seeds and harvest
groups.plain: A hard start raises questions, hints point ahead, the planted thing pays off, and the broken symbol says the theme.

groups.label: Time out of order
groups.plain: The story starts at the end, jumps around, lays memories over the present and reads an old diary aloud.

groups.label: Talking true to type
groups.plain: Under stress each character hides more under their words, and their way of talking stands out.

groups.label: Losing their place
groups.plain: Life starts falling, the circle shrinks, loneliness grows, and emotional health slips toward the stress type.

groups.label: The weight of the crown
groups.plain: They rise to the top, everyone leans on them, and when the nod is withheld they turn on the group.

groups.label: Needs, wants and drive
groups.plain: A starved need drives them, the blocked want raises the tension, the drive pulls the plot, and a met need finally brings peace.

groups.label: The shame loop
groups.plain: Shame rises, the urge for relief rises, in someone else's house the cabinet pulls, the pills are taken, and the shame comes back.

groups.label: The authority chain
groups.plain: An authority figure comes near, trust drops, a parent's voice gets louder, and the lies start.

groups.label: Safe harbor
groups.plain: Uneasy at parties and closed with strangers, but among spiritual seekers at the ashram they open up and belong.

groups.label: Starting over
groups.plain: Home feels like a trap, the drive to leave grows, the world makes the new craft easier, and their standing rises.

groups.label: The spiral alone
groups.plain: Alone and uneasy, the chaos rises, the voice turns cruel, they beat themselves up, reach for relief, and the inner hurdle grows.

groups.label: Finding calm
groups.plain: They laugh at the slip, the soothing works, the storm settles, the inner hurdle shrinks, and life climbs.

groups.label: The healing road
groups.plain: A healer comes near, they stay with the feeling instead of running, picture the best and the worst, learn to welcome the hard feelings, wake up, give more, and become a healer themselves.

groups.label: Long talk that snaps into violence: the moves
groups.plain: Talk long about odd little things, let the unease climb, lay a cheerful old song over cruelty, split the story into chapters, and hold the standoff in silence. In the spirit of Quentin Tarantino.

groups.label: Symmetry and deadpan pastel: the moves
groups.plain: Center the frame so the dry joke lands, keep the face flat as the feeling grows, whip the camera to the next neat picture, and let fussy details open onto sadness. In the spirit of Wes Anderson.

groups.label: Slow-burn dread: the moves
groups.plain: Let us know first, hold the camera too long, tighten the clock until the cuts speed up, and stop the music dead when the danger arrives. In the spirit of Alfred Hitchcock.

groups.label: Rapid-fire screwball: the moves
groups.plain: Overlap the lines so the spark grows, speed up so the chaos grows, keep cutting each other off, and save the biggest laugh for the calm one cracking. In the spirit of Howard Hawks.

groups.label: Handheld realism: the moves
groups.plain: Follow close so we feel with them, drop the music so the place speaks, let panic shake the camera, and hold long takes so the acting breathes. In the spirit of the Dardenne brothers.

groups.label: Silent-film physical comedy: the moves
groups.plain: Shoot the stunt wide so it is real, show the trap early, keep the face blank as the chaos grows, and let the music speak when no one does. In the spirit of Buster Keaton.

groups.label: Big blockbuster awe: the moves
groups.plain: Show the face before the wonder, keep the big thing hidden, swell the orchestra on the reveal, and bring the hero's tune back for the release. In the spirit of Steven Spielberg.

groups.label: Quiet family drama: the moves
groups.plain: End on the empty room, keep feelings inside until they weigh on us, hold the camera still and low, and let a departure leave the house lonely. In the spirit of Yasujiro Ozu.

groups.label: Neon noir: the moves
groups.plain: Wet the streets so the neon doubles, let a narrator bend the truth, bring strangers in as shadows, and bar the light like a cell. In the spirit of classic film noir and its neon-lit heirs.

groups.label: Mockumentary: the moves
groups.plain: Snap in on awkward faces, share a look at the lens, cut from the boast to the failure, and let people relax until secrets slip. In the spirit of Christopher Guest.

groups.label: Horror jump scare build: the moves
groups.plain: Drain the music, leave empty dark space to search, give a false scare first, then slam the real one loud. In the spirit of James Wan.

groups.label: Romantic comedy meet-cute: the moves
groups.plain: Bump them together, let the bickering warm them, pull them apart with a mix-up, and swell the music when they stand close. In the spirit of Nora Ephron.

groups.label: Heist caper: the moves
groups.plain: Lay out the plan, let it go wrong, cut between the crew as the clock and music speed up, and pay off the hidden part at the end. In the spirit of Steven Soderbergh.

groups.label: Coming of age: the moves
groups.plain: Play the song that brings the past back, walk them through the night until they open up, end the summer, and leave the old place behind. In the spirit of Richard Linklater.

groups.label: Musical number: the moves
groups.plain: Find the beat in everyday sounds, burst into song when talk is not enough, let the crowd join, and lift the camera at the peak. In the spirit of classic Hollywood musicals.

groups.label: Kitchen-sink realism: the moves
groups.plain: Let money troubles raise the voices, let trouble outside wear down the home, cut the music so small kindness lands, and let shame turn into resentment. In the spirit of Ken Loach.

groups.label: Genre spoof, gag after gag: the moves
groups.plain: Borrow the genre's rules so breaking them is funny, let the music show up in the room, wink about being a film, and top every pun. In the spirit of Mel Brooks.

groups.label: Absurd sketch logic: the moves
groups.plain: Let nobody blink, follow one silly idea with strict logic, answer foolish questions seriously, mock the people in charge, and stop the sketch the moment it goes too far. In the spirit of Monty Python.

groups.label: Fast visual comedy cut to the beat: the moves
groups.plain: Cut chores to the beat, put a sound on every move, plant jokes early to pay off late, land the action on the music, and whip from place to place. In the spirit of Edgar Wright.

groups.label: Loose improvised hangout comedy: the moves
groups.plain: Let the talk wander, roast with love, keep the real crack-ups, let a long scene find a true feeling, and cut to the listener. In the spirit of Judd Apatow.

groups.label: Dark comedy of bad plans: the moves
groups.plain: Lay out the plan so it can fall apart, let greed make every fix worse, let the lie turn violent, say awful things politely, and follow the shock with calm. In the spirit of the Coen brothers.

groups.label: Sweet clown with a broken heart: the moves
groups.plain: Let him lose so we root for him, bridge the laugh to tears with music, aim the gags upward, give him one small win, and let the face speak instead of words. In the spirit of Charlie Chaplin.

groups.label: Deadpan stillness and long pauses: the moves
groups.plain: Stretch the pause until it gets the laugh, keep everyone still so tiny reactions speak, keep faces blank so loneliness shows, hold each rare line, and say sad things flatly. In the spirit of Jim Jarmusch and Aki Kaurismaki.

groups.label: Rapid wordplay and wit: the moves
groups.plain: Hide a second meaning and fire one back, top every brilliant line, bring a phrase back with a new meaning, and speed up so the barbs get sharper. In the spirit of Billy Wilder and Preston Sturges.

groups.label: Squirm comedy of the clueless boss: the moves
groups.plain: Explain the dead joke so the silence grows, let neediness make it worse, have the boss play pal, and give them one moment of seeing themselves. In the spirit of Ricky Gervais.

groups.label: Gag every second, played straight: the moves
groups.plain: Keep the faces dead straight, show phrases word for word, fill every corner with gags, let the extras carry on, and let the story thin out under the jokes. In the spirit of the Zucker brothers and Jim Abrahams.

groups.label: One wild night teen comedy: the moves
groups.plain: Put a deadline on the night, drag the careful friend along, let the embarrassment become a legend, and let the truth come out at dawn. In the spirit of John Hughes and Greg Mottola.

groups.label: Romantic comedy of manners: the moves
groups.plain: Close the door and let us imagine, let polite words say the opposite, show the object that gives the secret away, and let jealousy simmer under perfect manners. In the spirit of Ernst Lubitsch.
